d: HanmiGlobal Saudi is seeking a detail-oriented and experienced Contract Administrator to join our team. The successful candidate will be responsible for managing contracts throughout their lifecycle, ensuring compliance with company policies and legal requirements, and fostering successful relationships with contractors and suppliers.
q: Proven experience as a Contract Administrator or in a similar role.
Strong understanding of contract law and legal terminology.
Proficiency in MS Office suite and contract management software.
Ability to work effectively with diverse teams and stakeholders.
Attention to detail and strong organizational skills.
Bachelor's degree in Business Administration, Law, Engineering, or related fields.
Minimum of 12 years of experience in contract administration within the construction or engineering industry is preferred.
Familiarity with Saudi Arabian contract regulations and standards is advantageous.
Fluency in English; Arabic language skills are a plus.
r: li
Prepare, review, and negotiate contract terms and conditions in alignment with company standards.
li
Maintain accurate records of contracts and related correspondence.
li
Coordinate with project managers, engineers, and subcontractors to ensure contract compliance.
li
Monitor contract deadlines, deliverables, and financial milestones.
li
Analyze contract risks and propose mitigation strategies.
li
Resolve any contract-related disputes or issues promptly.
li
Ensure all contracts adhere to legal and regulatory requirements.

d: We are seeking an experienced HR Advisor to drive strategic talent management initiatives, strengthen performance management frameworks, and support employee development and succession planning. The role will focus on building sustainable talent pipelines, enhancing organizational capability, and aligning people strategies with business objectives. A strong background in Talent Management, Performance Management, Succession Planning and Career Development, with demonstrated experience designing and implementing HR frameworks.
r: li
Design and implement talent management, career development and succession planning frameworks.
li
Develop and enhance performance management systems, policies and processes.
li
Identify and manage high-potential talent pools and critical leadership succession pipelines.
li
Lead critical role identification and job analysis to support workforce and organizational planning.
li
Partner with Learning & Development to align competency gaps, performance outcomes and career progression.
li
Drive HR policy improvements and strategic initiatives that strengthen employee engagement, retention and organizational effectiveness.

d: Act as the primary local legal liaison, ensuring that all legal advice, documentation, negotiations, regulatory matters, risk assessments, transactions, contracts, and other legal matters are coordinated with and reviewed by Legal Department at Headquarters, and are negotiated, executed, and delivered in compliance with applicable laws and regulations, internal policies, Legal Department requirements, and agreed timelines, while providing legal support to Regional Operations Directors on jurisdiction-specific requirements.
q: A Master’s degree in law is a plus.
At least 6-7 years as an in-house legal consultant within a corporate setting.
Experience working across multiple jurisdictions is an advantage.
Demonstrating sound professional judgment and diligence in the preparation and delivery of legal work, including the responsible use of technology and support tools.

Strong understanding of the UAE/GCC legal and regulatory landscape, including federal and Emirate-level laws, mainland and free zone regimes, licensing and government approval requirements, corporate and commercial laws, governance, employment, immigration, data protection, education-sector regulations, and the interaction between civil law, common law free zone systems.
r: li
Assist the Legal Department at the Headquarters in analyzing, managing, and advising on diverse legal and compliance matters.
li

Provide legal analysis and recommendations on matters relating to contract and tort law, employment law, corporate and commercial law, dispute resolution, and other relevant legal areas, and escalate material or complex legal matters to the Legal Department at Headquarters for guidance, review, and approval as required.
li

Draft and review a broad range of contracts and legal documents in coordination with the Legal Department at Headquarters, ensuring compliance with approved legal standards, internal approval processes, and risk management requirements. This includes routine operational documents as well as complex commercial agreements and strategic transactions.
li

Support the implementation of approved contract templates, policies, and procedures while administering the full contract lifecycle, including initiation, negotiation, execution, renewal, amendment, and termination.
li

Perform company secretarial functions as required, including preparing agendas, drafting and maintaining minutes of meetings, ensuring proper record‑keeping of corporate decisions, and supporting compliance with statutory and governance obligations.
li
Support the Legal Department at Headquarters by conducting legal research and analysis, preparing legal documentation, and coordinating legal matters across jurisdictions.
li

Monitor legislative and regulatory developments and ensure that the Legal Department at Headquarters is promptly informed of new laws, regulations, and compliance requirements relevant to the business.
li

Provide legal and administrative support to operational teams, including assisting with clerical tasks, maintaining legal records, managing document repositories and supporting legal process administration.
li
Identify, assess, and report on legal risks associated with business activities, transactions, and strategic initiatives.
li

Assist the Legal Department at Headquarters with the incorporation, restructuring, and maintenance of local, regional, and international entities, including the drafting and preparation of legal documentation and coordination with external counsel to ensure compliance with local legal requirements.
li

Support project managers and Regional Operations Director on legal matters arising from contract implementation and execution, and monitor compliance with contractual obligations and key milestones while ensuring alignment with the guidance, requirements, and directions of the Legal Department at Headquarters.
li
Liaise with regulators, governmental authorities, external counsel, and other relevant stakeholders on legal and compliance matters.
li
Provide legal advice and support to operations on material legal matters and key initiatives, including regulatory compliance, contracts, governance, disputes, and legal risk assessment, as required.
li
Performing other legal-related tasks as they arise and as delegated by the Legal department at the Headquarters.

d: Secondary Teacher of Biology at Safa Community School, Dubai

Safa Community School is a beacon of excellence. In 2024 we were honoured with the ‘Happiest School in the UAE’ title, and we received the ‘Value Add, Leaving No Child Behind Award’, backed by a GCSE VA score of +2.2. Our high staff retention and top 15 UAE ranking (Schoolscompared.com) reflect a warm, inclusive community in which students, parents and staff all feel at home.
Safa is an award-winning, all-through UK curriculum school from FS1 to Year 13 with [number] students, and around 35% of our parents are from the UK. Follow us on Instagram at safa_scs.

We are looking for a dynamic and passionate Biology Teacher to join our accomplished Science department. The successful candidate will teach Biology across KS3 and KS4 (including Combined Science where required) and to A-Level. This role is advertised as part of our strategic growth to meet increasing enrolment and programme demand.
Plan and prepare courses and lessons; set and mark work; assess, record and report on progress and attainment in line with school policy.
Use data to inform teaching, track progress and put timely interventions in place.
Prepare students for GCSE/IGCSE and A-Level examinations, including assessment, reporting and attending exam-related meetings.
Deliver practical and fieldwork-based learning safely and effectively, following risk assessments and the school’s health and safety policies; support required practicals and practical endorsement.
Work with the science technicians to plan and prepare practical lessons and manage living materials appropriately.
Communicate with parents, write reports and attend Parents’ Evenings and Open Evenings.
Maintain good order and discipline among students.
Contribute to departmental meetings, schemes of work, and methods of teaching and assessment.
Keep up to date with curriculum innovation and engage in CPD.
Work collaboratively with support teachers, and support a beginning teacher where appropriate.
Set work for known absences and cover for absent colleagues where required.
Take responsibility for a designated area of the curriculum, administration or a project (for example eco-initiatives, STEM enrichment or Biology Olympiad preparation).
Carry out other tasks reasonably directed by the Head of Department.
Familiarise yourself with the DSIB inspection framework; be supportive of UAE initiatives and cultural expectations.
Will hold relevant qualifications (a degree in Biology or a related life science plus a recognised teaching qualification).
Must have experience teaching Biology in British Curriculum schools at both GCSE/IGCSE and A-Level.
Is enthusiastic about Biology and able to inspire students.
Understands assessment and examination requirements for KS3, KS4 and KS5.
Is an outstanding teacher, committed to a strong practical and inquiry-led approach.
Works effectively as part of a team and keeps up to date with subject developments.
Is willing to develop professionally within or beyond the department.
Closing date: Friday, 11 December 2026 at 10h00 UAE time. Applications are assessed in order of receipt and we reserve the right to appoint before the closing date.
Apply only through the TES/Schrole Portal; only applicants with GCSE and A-Level teaching experience will be considered.
Submit an up-to-date, full CV and a covering letter of no more than two A4 pages.
Provide at least three referees (with international dialling codes and emails); one must be a current employer.
A demonstration lesson will be required. Feedback is provided only to candidates who progress to interview.
